v1.body: Paste a receipt, charge notice or subscription screenshot to extract the amount, billing cycle and dates for review.

v2.body: Ask about charges in a date range, upcoming payments or spending by category and payment method.

v3.title: Update a subscription
v3.body: Specify a new price and its start date, pause a subscription or stop renewal. Review the draft before saving.

v4.title: Track shared payments
v4.body: Check shared-plan members, amounts due and payments received, or prepare a receipt draft.
